title: Unit Review: Formal Registers and Arguedas
goal: Review nouns, impersonal style, concession, letters and participle clauses, through a text about José María Arguedas.
grammar: Unit Review: Formal Registers and Arguedas

items: I can read a short text about José María Arguedas and his novel Los ríos profundos.
I can write formal sentences with nouns, impersonal *se* and participle clauses.
I can grant a point and write a formal letter opening.
